div.head: II Cn 84.4
div.ab: And don nu eac lareowas ⁊ godcunde bydelas, swa swa hit riht is ⁊ ealra manna þearf is: bodian gelome godcunde þearfe.
And do nu eac lareowas ⁊ godcunde bydelas, swa swa riht is ⁊ ealra manna ðearf is: bodian gelome godcunde ðearfe.
And don nu eac læreowas ⁊ godcunde bydelas, swa hit riht is ⁊ ealswa manna þearf is: bodian gelome godcunde þearfe.
Et faciant doctores et Dei precones, sicut rectum est et omnibus necessarium: predicent sepius quę ad Deum pertinent.
Faciant eciam doctores et diuini precones ita [ut] iustum est et omnium hominum necessitas est: pre[dice]nt frequenter spiritualem utilitatem.
And do nu eac lareowas ⁊ godcunde bydelas swa swa riht is ⁊ ealra manna ðearf is: bodian gelome godcunde ðearfe.
And don nu eac lareowas and godcunde bydelas, swa swa hit riht is and ealra manna þearf is: bodian gelome godcunde þearfe.
Und mögen nun auch Lehrer und geistliche Herolde so handeln wie es recht ist und aller (ebenfalls wie A) Menschen Nutzen, [nämlich] häufig geistliche Pflicht(en?) predigen.
And let teachers and spiritual heralds now also act as is right and to the benefit of all (likewise as, A) people, [namely] preach frequently [their] spiritual duty (duties?).
And likewise teachers and spiritual messengers shall do what is right and for the well-being of all men: they shall frequently inculcate spiritual duties.
And likewise, let teachers and spiritual ministers do what is right and necessary for all people: frequently preach their spiritual obligations.
